info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Advertising Conversion…
info.description: Exposes API endpoints for managing advertising conversion export configurations. These methods let users list, inspect, create, update, and delete configured exports and access tokens.

item.name: Advertising conversion export get conversion exports

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
The numeric ID of the website to query. When omitted, exports for all sites with write access are returned.

request.description: Returns configured conversion exports for one site or for every site the current user can manage.

response.name:
The configured conversion exports keyed by numeric array index.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

item.name: Advertising conversion export add conversion export

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the website the export belongs to.
(Required) The export name shown in the Matomo UI.
(Required) The export type ID, for example `GoogleAds`, `MicrosoftAds`, or `YandexAds`.
(Required) Export settings including selected goals, export windows, attribution options, and an optional segment filter.
A free-text description for the export.
